deployments_detail.use: Edge AI camera (with RUTILEA) for factory work visualization/monitoring

Generative AI specialized for equipment maintenance, trained on factory-floor maintenance records. It preprocesses inconsistently formatted maintenance logs so that less-experienced personnel can work at veteran-level efficiency, reducing maintenance time. Continuously improved with field feedback (response time cut to one-fifth, voice input added). [Murata in-house]
deployments_detail.value: Response time reduced to one-fifth of previous levels

deployments_detail.use: Sensor-based AI/IoT predictive maintenance implemented at Fukui Murata Manufacturing. Sensors on machinery collect performance data; a dedicated team sets alert thresholds and detects impending failures. Started as a single-line pilot, then expanded across lines. [Murata (sensors/IoT + AI analytics)]
deployments_detail.value: 3 years after project start, corrective maintenance time reduced by half; improved operating ratio and output on trial line

deployments_detail.use: AI-based automation of skilled/tacit manufacturing techniques: analyzing and visualizing expert insights so robotic systems can reproduce precise expert movements, achieving consistent high-quality manufacturing independent of human expertise across global facilities. [Murata in-house]

AI + IoT data-analysis and optimization technology that sends optimal real-time instructions to AGVs and robots on the factory floor based on work progress and on-site changes, improving efficiency and safety. [Murata in-house]

AI-based quality inspection: automated detection of product characteristic anomalies to address inconsistencies in human inspection results, leveraging the vast data from hundreds of millions of products produced daily. [Murata data-science teams (in-house models)]

Generative AI to automatically generate development-language code (Verilog HDL, VHDL, C/C++, Python), 3D models, illustrations, robot operation-control programs, and circuit designs from natural-language instructions for device/system development. Described in cautious/forward-looking terms — emerging attempts rather than an established production system. [not disclosed]

AI customer-service routing system that analyzes inquiry content and directs customer inquiries to the most appropriate department, reducing response times. [Murata data-science teams (in-house models)]

"Murata Coworker" — internally developed generative AI assistant rolled out to all employees in Oct 2024 (following the "Murata Copilot" beta ~1 year earlier). Multimodal (text, Word, PDF, images, audio) with RAG over internal knowledge; used by ~27,000 employees as of July 31, 2025. A Generative AI Center of Excellence was established March 2024 to build it. [Murata in-house (LLM provider not disclosed)]
deployments_detail.value: Improved work efficiency of more than 3 hours/month per user; several billion yen per year in company-wide economic benefit; ~27,000 users

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven production planning automation: using accumulated big data to automatically propose optimal production plans. [Murata data-science teams (in-house models)]
Internal web-analytics tool that uses AI to extract latent customer needs from web access data and recommend optimal products to customers. [Murata data-science teams (in-house models)]

Small Language Model (SLM) developed to automatically extract and mask personally identifiable information (individual names, company names, department names) before feeding internal documents to LLM services — enabling secure enterprise LLM use. Built with open-source Llama-series SLMs, PEFT fine-tuning, and a 1,000-document internal dataset (515 EN / 485 JP). Presented at the 2025 JSAI conference; described as exploratory research, not yet a deployed product. [Murata (open-source Llama models + PEFT)]
